title: CM: fix costing proposal setup TS2559 without changing costing behaviour
public_pr_body:
Fixes TS2559 on the held codex/costing-sql-test-plan branch by explicitly passing its two existing environment options as the default argument. Both values are still read at call time; acknowledgement, isolation, install and cleanup behaviour are unchanged. One source line changed. No costing engine, rates, golden answers, SQL or assertions changed.

Reproduced before fix: `npx tsc --noEmit` exited 2 with tests/support/costing-proposal-setup.ts(20,46) TS2559. After fix: `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0. `npx eslint app components lib tests/support/costing-proposal-setup.ts tests/unit/costing-proposal-setup.test.ts` exits 0, zero errors and three existing warnings (job-photos/rework-dialog/outbox). `npx vitest run tests/unit/costing-proposal-setup.test.ts`: 9 passed, zero failures/skips.

Local validation used the held source reconstructed exactly from local 039529b plus the four-file remote delta to 6431e602, with shared preinstalled dependencies; no clean install or DB/runtime claim. Draft targets the held branch; Claude Code can apply after review. No main merge, production SQL, Ready label or broad audit.

- [x] TS2559 reproduced and fixed; typecheck/lint and 9 setup tests pass
- [ ] Independent review and exact-head CI
